name: TemperatureMonitor
description: Monitored DS18B20 temperature channels on one 1-Wire bus for ESP32, ESP8266 and AVR (Arduino). Address-bound slots stored with their configuration, discovery and automatic reconnection, a non-blocking measuring cycle, events for every state change (including MISSING and OFF), and address-guarded configuration changes. Built on RangeMonitor and DS18B20Sensor; no dynamic allocation; host-testable.
keywords: temperature, monitor, alarm, ds18b20, onewire, 1-wire, freezer, cold room, nvs, freertos
